Wisdom is a digital platform that allows people looking for services to find, compare, contact, book, and pay individuals or legal entities that offer them.

By creating an account, publishing a service, making or accepting a booking, subscribing to Wisdom Premium, or using any functionality that requires acceptance of these Terms, you declare that you have read and accepted them.
Simply browsing the parts of Wisdom available without registration does not constitute the contracting of a professional service.

These Terms must be interpreted in conjunction with the Privacy Policy, Reservation Policy, Cancellation Policy, Billing and Taxation Policy, Wisdom Premium Policy and the Service Fee. The scope of support, disputes and refunds is governed by these Terms and the booking and cancellation policies.

Unless expressly stated otherwise, references to “Wisdom” in these Terms refer to the owner and the Wisdom technology platform.
2. Definitions
For the purposes of these Terms:
“User” means any person who accesses or uses Wisdom.
“Client” means the user who uses Wisdom to search for, request, or contract a service.

“Professional” or “Service Provider” means the natural or legal person identified in the offer who publishes and provides the service to the Client. This is a functional designation within the platform: it does not certify registration as self-employed, business status, qualifications, authorization or tax compliance. It may include a person who declares that they act as a private individual.
“Service” means the activity offered by a Professional and contracted or available for contracting through Wisdom.

“Reservation” is the record of the request, acceptance and management of a Service between Client and Provider. The Service contract, entered into between them, and the intermediation relationship and use of the platform with Wisdom must be distinguished.
“Payout Amount” means the amount corresponding to the work carried out by the Professional.

“Service fee” is the amount charged by Wisdom for its intermediation, infrastructure, payment management through specialized providers, its own documentation and support. It is not an insurance premium or the price of a guarantee of the Lender's work.
“Premium” means the subscription service that provides certain additional benefits in accordance with the Premium Policy.
3. Nature of Wisdom
Wisdom is a marketplace and provider of digital intermediary services.

Wisdom provides the technological infrastructure necessary for Clients and Professionals to find each other, communicate, organize services, make bookings, make payments, manage documentation, leave reviews, and use support mechanisms.

Wisdom does not offer or execute the services published by the Providers, does not acquire their ownership and does not resell them to the Client. The publication, recommendation, reservation or payment through the platform does not make Wisdom the provider of those services.

The contract relating to the Service is concluded directly between the Client and the Provider identified in the offer and reservation. The Provider is the offeror and responsible for the execution of the obligations associated with its activity and for issuing the invoice for the Service when legally applicable. Wisdom contracts with the user only its own platform services.

The Professional decides which services they offer, their characteristics, price or pricing system, availability, and other conditions within the options permitted by the platform, and decides whether to accept or reject requests received.

The use of Wisdom does not in itself create an employment, corporate, franchise relationship or provision of the Service on behalf of Wisdom. Authorizations to process collections, refunds or communications are instrumental to the intermediation and do not authorize Wisdom to execute the work or issue invoices for the Provider.
This contractual classification does not replace any mandatory rules that may apply based on the actual circumstances of a relationship.
4. Client and Professional May Be the Same Person
A Wisdom account may be used both to contract and to offer services.
A user may act as a Client in one transaction and as a Professional in another.
The applicable obligations will depend on the role being performed at each moment.
5. Minimum Age
To create an account and use Wisdom’s transactional functionalities, you must be at least 18 years old and have sufficient legal capacity to enter into contracts.
Creating an account on behalf of a minor or allowing a minor to use an account as if it were their own is not permitted.
Wisdom may request information reasonably necessary to verify a user’s age or identity where there are grounds to do so.
6. Creating an Account
The user must provide truthful, complete, and up-to-date information.
It may be necessary to provide, among other information, a name, email address, profile information, and any additional information required to use certain functions.
The user is responsible for keeping their account information up to date.
Impersonating another person, creating accounts using false information, using another person’s identity without authorization, or providing forged documents is not permitted.
Wisdom may verify certain information where necessary for security, payments, regulatory compliance, or operation of the platform.
7. Account Security
Login credentials are personal.
The user must take reasonable measures to prevent unauthorized access and notify Wisdom of any suspected misuse.
Transactions carried out from an authenticated account may be considered to have been performed by its owner unless there are indications of fraudulent access or evidence to the contrary.
Wisdom may request additional verification for logins, payments, sensitive changes, or behavior it considers unusual.
8. Public Information and Profiles
Certain information may be displayed publicly so that Wisdom can operate as a marketplace.
For Professionals, this may include name, photograph, description, experience, services, prices, languages, previous work, ratings, activity metrics, badges, or other relevant information.
Users are responsible for the truthfulness of the content they publish.
Presenting qualifications, credentials, licenses, experience, photographs, work, ratings, or accreditations belonging to other people as your own is not permitted.
9. Professional Status
Wisdom allows different types of people to offer services provided that they may legally do so.
Depending on the activity, frequency, income, country, and circumstances of the Provider, legislation may impose different obligations.
The Professional is responsible for determining whether they must, among other obligations:
Register as self-employed or an equivalent status.
Complete tax or census registrations.
Operate through a company.
Hold licenses or authorizations.
Belong to a professional association.
Hold specific qualifications.
Take out mandatory insurance.
Apply taxes.
Declaring income.
Issuing invoices.
Comply with labor, health, administrative, or sector-specific obligations.

Wisdom does not carry out a general audit of the fiscal, labor or administrative situation of the Providers nor does it certify their registrations, licenses, insurance or qualifications. The information declared is the responsibility of the Provider. This absence of audit does not exclude specific verifications, actions in the event of signs of irregularity or information and diligence obligations that legally correspond to Wisdom or its suppliers.
Using Wisdom does not replace any tax, legal, employment, or professional advice that each Provider may need.
10. Professional, Businessperson, or Private Individual

When setting up their payout method, the Service Provider declares whether they act as an “Individual” or as “Self-Employed / Company”. “Individual” identifies the natural person who has selected and confirmed that status, without Wisdom having audited their tax situation. It does not mean a tax-exempt person, a person authorized to operate without mandatory registrations, or a person whose absence of an invoicing obligation has been verified.

“Self-employed / Company” identifies those who declare that they act as an entrepreneur or professional and that they are registered in accordance with the requirements of their activity. This selection also does not constitute a Wisdom certification. The actual legal status depends on the activity and the applicable regulations, not the name chosen in the app.

The Service Provider must expressly and truthfully declare their current status and correct it whenever it changes. When selecting “Self-Employed / Company”, they must accept: “I declare that I am registered as self-employed or as a company for the activity I offer and that this information is true and up to date. I undertake to keep it up to date and to comply with my legal and tax obligations. I understand that Wisdom does not audit or certify this declaration and that I am responsible for any falsehood in it and for my own non-compliance, without prejudice to the checks and legal obligations of Wisdom and the payment provider”. Not completing the configuration or making an express declaration is not equivalent to declaring that one acts as a private individual.

Before contracting, the Client must know the identity of the Service Provider, the capacity in which the Service Provider declares that they act, and the allocation of obligations. When the Service Provider declares that they act as a private individual and not as a trader or professional, it will be expressly stated that consumer and user protection legislation does not apply to the Service contract if the Service Provider does not in fact act as a trader. An incorrect declaration does not remove the Client’s legal rights or change their rights against Wisdom in respect of the platform service.
Where the Provider acts as a businessperson or professional, they will be responsible for complying with the obligations imposed on the service provider by consumer and user regulations.
Wisdom may request additional information or carry out checks where there is a legal obligation to verify traders operating on the platform.

Falsehood or concealment regarding the Service Provider’s status breaches these Terms and does not transfer the Service Provider’s own obligations to Wisdom. Wisdom may request a correction or documentation, restrict collections or publications where appropriate, suspend the account and cooperate with authorities within legal limits. The Service Provider will be liable for harm causally attributable to their non-compliance in accordance with the law; damage caused by Wisdom or unlimited costs are not automatically attributed to the Service Provider.
11. Regulated Services
Some categories available on Wisdom may be subject to specific regulation.
The technical possibility of publishing a Service within a category does not mean that every user is legally authorized to provide it.

Where an activity requires a qualification, professional registration, license, authorization, insurance, certification, or equivalent requirement, it is the Professional’s responsibility to have these in place before offering or performing the Service.
Wisdom may request supporting documentation and restrict or remove services where there are reasonable doubts regarding compliance with such requirements.
12. Information About Services
The Professional must describe their services clearly, truthfully, and sufficiently.
Relevant information may include what is offered, what is excluded, price, calculation method, format, location, travel radius, experience, duration, availability, and any other relevant condition.
Publishing misleading information about a Service is not permitted.
The Client must read the listing, price, and conditions before booking and ask any relevant questions that are not sufficiently clear.
13. Booking Operation
The full rules governing requests, acceptance, availability, deposits, modifications, performance, completion, payments, recurring bookings, and disputes are set out in the Booking Policy.
Making a request does not mean that the Professional has accepted it.
The contract for the provision of the Service is subject to the corresponding acceptance and to the conditions displayed during the contracting process.
Accepting a booking also does not mean that the Service has materially begun.
Performance is managed in accordance with the workflow defined by Wisdom.
14. Price and Service Fee
The price of a transaction may consist of the Payout Amount corresponding to the Professional and Wisdom’s Service Fee.
Unless a different condition is indicated before contracting, Wisdom’s standard Service Fee is calculated as:
max. (€1, 10% of the Payout Amount + €0.50).
Therefore, the Service Fee will never be less than €1.
Where Wisdom Premium or another valid promotion applies, different conditions may be used, which will be shown to the user where appropriate.
Applicable taxes and the corresponding breakdown will be displayed in accordance with applicable tax and invoicing rules.
15. Deposits
Wisdom uses deposits for certain bookings to confirm the commitment of the parties.
The deposit may cover all or part of the Service Fee depending on the type of booking.
For services subject to a quote, a minimum deposit may be used.
The specific conditions are displayed before confirming the transaction.
Deposit refunds are governed by the Booking Policy and the Cancellation Policy.
16. Payments

Payments are processed through specialized providers, primarily Stripe. Wisdom uses a system of separate charges and transfers: the Client is charged and the corresponding amount is subsequently transferred to the Service Provider, with Wisdom retaining the Service Fee due to it. This payment management does not change who provides the Service or who must issue its invoice.
Wisdom may use tokenization mechanisms to enable subsequent payments related to a booking without directly storing complete card details.
Where the booking allows it and the user has authorized the corresponding mechanism, the method initially used may subsequently be used to make the final payment.
Certain methods, such as some wallets, may require a new confirmation by the user.

The Client authorizes the charges provided for and accepted for their booking; the Service Provider authorizes Wisdom to communicate to the payment provider the appropriate collection, transfer, temporary hold, refund or reversal instructions under these policies and the law. A confirmed payment discharges the Client’s debt for the amount paid, without prejudice to legally appropriate adjustments or reversals; a delay in the transfer does not permit charging the Client the same amount again. The full rules are explained in the Booking Policy.
17. Payment Obligation
The Client agrees to pay the amounts validly generated by the services contracted.
The fact that a payment attempt fails does not extinguish the corresponding obligation.

Where a payment method is rejected, expires, has insufficient funds, or requires additional authentication, Wisdom may request another method or restrict certain functionalities until the outstanding amount is resolved.
18. Automatic Charges
For certain bookings, Wisdom may automatically process the final charge where the conditions previously accepted by the Client are met.
The system, its limits, deadlines, and exceptions are explained in the Booking Policy.

Among other protections, Wisdom does not apply the ordinary automatic charging mechanism where the final price exceeds the established tolerance limits, where there is no sufficiently comparable estimate, in certain services subject to a quote, or where the payment method used necessarily requires express authorization for the new charge.
19. Payments to Professionals
Amounts corresponding to the Professional are transferred in accordance with the payout system established by Wisdom and the corresponding financial provider.

Affected amounts may remain temporarily pending transfer due to a dispute, indications of fraud, a chargeback, a legal obligation, a pending verification or a payment provider restriction. The measure must have a specific cause, be proportionate and be reviewed for as long as it continues; its reason and status will be communicated unless prevented by legal or security considerations. Once the cause has been resolved, the appropriate disposition of the funds will be processed without undue delay. The hold does not certify the quality of the Service or constitute insurance or a guarantee of payment.

The times for funds to arrive in the bank account are estimates and also depend on the provider and financial institutions. Wisdom retains its obligations in relation to its own management and to the payment provider; acting as an intermediary does not eliminate any charges, refunds or chargebacks that the provider may charge to Wisdom under its contract.
20. Transactions Outside Wisdom

Users must not use Wisdom to find each other and deliberately move a transaction originating on Wisdom outside the platform for the purpose of avoiding its fees, payment systems, security measures, or policies.
Repeatedly requesting or encouraging direct payment outside Wisdom in order to circumvent applicable conditions is not permitted.

Where a transaction is carried out outside Wisdom, the platform may lack sufficient information, traceability, and control to apply its payment, protection, support, invoicing, or dispute resolution systems.
Wisdom may take measures against deliberate attempts to circumvent the platform.
21. Chat and Communications
Wisdom provides messaging tools to facilitate communication between users.
Messages must be used lawfully, professionally, and respectfully.
It is prohibited to use chat to:
Harass, threaten, or intimidate.
Send spam.
Commit fraud.
Request illegal activities.
Distribute malware.
Share unlawful content.
Deliberately circumvent Wisdom’s systems.
Wisdom may establish message limits before a booking is made.
Once a booking is confirmed, those limits may be increased or removed depending on how the platform operates.
22. Contact Information Detection and Automated Moderation
Wisdom may use automated systems to detect phone numbers, email addresses, links, circumvention attempts, spam, fraud, and other conduct contrary to the platform’s rules.
These systems may block content, warn the user, record an incident, or refer certain cases for human review.
Moderation decisions will be applied with the aim of being objective and proportionate to the conduct detected.
Where required by law, Wisdom will inform the user of the restrictions applied and the available mechanisms for requesting a review.

Wisdom may not be used to:

Offer prohibited goods or services.
Commit or facilitate fraud.
Impersonate others.
Manipulate reviews.
Create fake bookings.
Tamper with payment systems.

Deliberately conceal relevant information.
Infringe intellectual property rights.
Access accounts, systems, or information without authorization.
Extract data on a large scale through unauthorized mechanisms.
Introduce malware or harmful code.
Interfere with Wisdom’s infrastructure.
Artificially manipulate rankings, metrics, searches, or reputation.
Use multiple accounts to circumvent restrictions.
Use the platform to harass, discriminate against, or threaten others.
Wisdom may investigate such conduct and take proportionate measures.
24. Prohibited Services
Services whose provision is illegal or infringes third-party rights may not be offered.
Wisdom may establish additional restrictions for legal, security, financial, or operational reasons, or due to the requirements of its providers.
The absence of an express prohibition on a category does not mean that an illegal activity is permitted.
25. Reviews and Reputation
Clients may review services they have contracted in accordance with Wisdom’s rules.
Reviews must reflect a genuine experience and may not be used to extort, threaten, or manipulate another person.
The following are prohibited:
Buying or selling reviews.
Creating fictitious bookings to obtain reviews.
Leaving reviews through accounts controlled by the same user.
Offering compensation conditional on a positive review.
Threatening a negative review in order to obtain an improper advantage.
Wisdom may remove content where there are sufficient indications of fraud, illegal content, impersonation, harassment, or other violations.
A negative review will not be removed solely because it is unfavorable to the Professional.
26. Rankings and Recommendations
Wisdom may rank and recommend services using different parameters.

These may include, among others, relevance to the search, location, availability, price, rating, activity, profile quality or completeness, reliability, responsiveness, history, service format, and certain legitimate Premium benefits.
Wisdom may modify its ranking systems to improve the operation of the platform, prevent abuse, or adapt recommendations.
General information about the main ranking parameters will be made available in an accessible manner where required by law.
27. Wisdom Premium
Wisdom may offer a Premium subscription with additional benefits.
Its specific conditions are set out in the Premium Policy and in the information displayed before purchase.
Plans may include benefits such as higher publishing limits, badges, additional functionality, financial benefits, positioning, statistics, support, or other features.
Premium does not guarantee a specific number of views, requests, bookings, or income.
28. Premium on iOS
When Premium is purchased on iOS through an In-App Purchase subscription, Apple manages the payment, renewal, payment method, cancellation, and documentation relating to the payment.
Wisdom receives the information necessary to determine whether the user retains the right to Premium access.
Renewals, refunds, revocations, and changes managed by Apple may subsequently modify the Premium status of the account.
Restoring a valid purchase does not constitute a new purchase and must not generate a second charge.
29. Premium Outside iOS
Where Premium is managed directly through a provider such as Stripe, the conditions displayed during the purchase process and the Premium Policy will apply.
Automatically renewing subscriptions will continue to renew while active and not cancelled in accordance with the relevant conditions.
Cancelling renewal does not necessarily mean immediately losing the Premium period already paid for.
30. Promotions and Codes
Wisdom may offer discounts, promotional codes, free periods, or Premium access granted on an exceptional basis.
Promotions may be subject to duration, eligibility, territory, maximum number of uses, or other specific conditions.
Using multiple accounts, false identities, or other methods to repeatedly obtain benefits intended for a single user is prohibited.
Wisdom may cancel a promotion obtained fraudulently.
31. Cancellations
The cancellation rules for Services are explained in the Cancellation Policy and the Booking Policy.
Depending on the timing, status, and responsible party, a cancellation may result in:
A full refund.
Loss of the deposit.
Cancellation without penalty.
Recording of a reliability incident.
Entry into dispute.
Other consequences provided for in the applicable policies.
Relevant conditions must be displayed before the user confirms an action where appropriate.
32. Statutory Right of Withdrawal
Wisdom’s internal policies do not remove any rights that a consumer has by law.
Where applicable law recognizes a right of withdrawal, that right will be respected regardless of ordinary cancellation rules.
For certain service contracts, the consumer may have a statutory withdrawal period from the date of contracting.
If they expressly request that a service begin during that period, the consequences provided for by law may apply.

Where the service has been fully performed after the consumer expressly requested that it begin and acknowledged that they would lose the right of withdrawal once performance was complete, that right may expire in accordance with applicable law.
These rules will also depend on whether the Provider actually acts as a businessperson or professional in relation to a consumer.
33. Disputes
Wisdom provides internal mechanisms for reporting incidents and opening disputes.

Wisdom may review the pertinent information of the reservation, payments, times, communications and evidence provided. It will give the parties a reasonable opportunity to explain their position, except for justified urgent measures, and will communicate the operational result and the possibility of requesting a review. It does not carry out a technical appraisal of the work nor does it guarantee reaching an agreement.
Wisdom may make operational decisions on the platform, for example:
Process or withhold a payment.
Issue a refund.
Cancel a booking.
Maintain a transaction.
Request additional information.
Apply a measure to an account.

Assistance in reaching agreements and internal dispute management do not constitute arbitration, judicial resolution or formal regulated mediation. Wisdom's decisions order the operation of the platform and payments in accordance with the accepted conditions, without definitively resolving civil responsibilities between the parties. None prevents going to authorities, applicable resolution mechanisms or courts.

Wisdom may provide the other party with identification details, contact details or evidence strictly necessary for a specific claim where there is a legal basis, in accordance with the Privacy Policy. It will not indiscriminately disclose identity documents, bank details or unrelated conversations.

Wisdom offers support, traceability and dispute management tools. It does not offer damage insurance, a satisfaction guarantee, a certification of the result of the Service or general coverage of the Provider's obligations.

The ordinary financial remedy that Wisdom processes within a dispute concerns the booking amounts: it may consist of paying them out or making a full or partial refund where appropriate. Merely using the platform does not mean that Wisdom contractually assumes compensation for personal injury, property damage, loss of income or breaches by the Service Provider. This limitation does not restrict claims against the responsible party or Wisdom’s own responsibilities.

Extraordinary commercial aid will only exist if Wisdom grants it expressly for the specific case, with its scope documented, and does not create general coverage or a mandatory precedent. The Provider is not guaranteed payment for services that are not charged, canceled or subject to a proper refund. A refund does not in itself imply that the Client renounces further actions; nor does it allow the same concept to be recovered twice.

The Service Provider is responsible for the offer, scope, price and conditions agreed with the Client, for correctly performing the Service, and for the acts of the people used to provide it where legally attributable to the Service Provider. The Service Provider bears the applicable legal obligations concerning guarantees for the work, handling complaints, remedying defects and liability for damage in accordance with the law.

Reviews, statistics, position in results and Premium badges are platform information; they do not in themselves establish solvency, tax registration, licenses, insurance, professional competence or quality of work. A tax status label describes what the Service Provider has declared.

Interruptions may occur due to maintenance, updates, errors, third-party incidents, operating systems, payment providers, map services, Internet infrastructure, or other causes.
Wisdom will seek to resolve incidents under its control within a reasonable period.

Use of such services may additionally be subject to their own terms and policies.

41. Professional Taxation
Each Professional is responsible for determining and complying with their own tax obligations.
This includes, where applicable:

Filing tax returns.
Keeping books or records.

Registering in the relevant tax censuses or schemes.

Wisdom does not turn undeclared income into legally exempt income and cannot authorize a user to breach their tax obligations.

The Provider is responsible for the tax and identity data that it declares and the tax treatment of its services. In the current modality, Wisdom does not configure or apply the taxes of a Service invoice on behalf of the Provider, nor does it generate that invoice on its behalf.

Wisdom facilitates the making available of documents issued by the Provider and information on the operation. The hosting of a file or the technical acceptance of its data does not imply tax advice, validation of its content or certification of its tax compliance.
If a Professional provides false or incorrect tax information, they may be liable for the consequences resulting from that declaration.

The Fee for the Wisdom service and the work of the Provider are different concepts and have different issuers: Oier Hernanz Arroyo, under the commercial name Wisdom, with respect to the platform, and the Provider with respect to the Service.
Wisdom will issue documentation relating to its own services where legally required.
The invoice relating to the professional service corresponds to the Service Provider.
The full rules are set out in the Invoicing and Tax Policy.
44. Invoices provided by the Provider

Wisdom does not currently offer to issue invoices for and on behalf of Service Providers. There is no active delegation of that function or automatic generation of their invoices or corrective invoices.

The Provider generates its invoice by its own means when obliged and may attach it to the reservation for the Client to consult or download. The document must identify the Provider as issuer, not Wisdom.

The Service Provider is responsible for the authenticity, content, numbering, tax details, taxes and correction of their document. Wisdom may carry out technical file checks and act in response to incidents or legal duties without assuming its issuance or guaranteeing the file’s validity for tax purposes.

The “Individual” category and the availability of buttons in the application do not eliminate a legal obligation to bill. If the classification is incorrect, the Provider must correct it and provide the required documentation by an appropriate means. Wisdom's receipts accredit platform movements and do not replace that invoice.
45. Liability for Tax Irregularities
The Professional may not attribute to Wisdom responsibility for tax violations resulting from:
Failure to declare income.
Incorrectly declaring their activity.
Failure to complete a mandatory registration.
Applying an incorrect tax due to false or incorrect information provided by them.

Providing false information about their tax status.
Failing to file their tax returns.
Wisdom will cooperate with authorities where legally required to do so.
The above does not exclude any liability that may correspond to Wisdom for failing to comply with its own legal obligations.
46. DAC7 and Reporting to Tax Authorities
Wisdom will comply with reporting obligations applicable to digital platform operators, including rules derived from DAC7 where applicable.
For this purpose, it may request, verify, retain, and disclose information relating to certain Providers.

The information may include, where legally required, identity, address, tax residence, tax identification, date of birth, company information, financial account details, consideration received, transactions carried out, and fees or commissions.
The fact that Wisdom reports information to a tax authority does not mean that it calculates or pays the Professional’s personal taxes.
Each Provider remains responsible for their own tax obligations.
47. KYC and Identity Verification
Wisdom or its financial providers may require identification and verification processes.
These checks may require personal information, identity documentation, business information, address, bank account, beneficial owners, or other legally required information.
Failure to complete a verification may prevent the user from accepting bookings, receiving funds, or using certain functionalities.
Passing a KYC process does not constitute a general certification of a person’s conduct, solvency, professional competence, or tax compliance.
48. Cooperation With Authorities
Wisdom may retain and disclose information where validly required by a competent authority or where there is a legal obligation.
This may relate to judicial, tax, or regulatory investigations, fraud prevention, security, or other obligations.
Wisdom is not required to conceal transactions or information in order to help a user break the law.

Unless expressly authorized, it is not permitted to:

By publishing content, the user grants Wisdom a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to the extent necessary to store, reproduce, technically adapt, display, and distribute such content within Wisdom and to operate, protect, and promote the platform or the Service itself.
This license does not mean that Wisdom acquires ownership of the content.
The user declares that they have sufficient rights or authorization to use anything they publish.
Wisdom may remove content that infringes third-party rights or these Terms.
51. Images and Work Belonging to Third Parties
A Professional must not publish photographs of work, people, spaces, designs, or works where they do not have the right to do so.
Where identifiable people appear, applicable privacy and image rights regulations must be respected.
Responsibility for obtaining the necessary authorizations initially lies with the user who publishes the content.
52. Content Moderation
Wisdom may moderate information published by users.
Moderation may involve automated systems, internal rules, and human review.
Among other purposes, it may be used to detect:
Illegal content.
Fraud.
Spam.
Contact information prohibited in certain contexts.
Impersonation.
Review manipulation.
Harassment.

About Wisdom
What is Wisdom?
Wisdom is a platform to find, compare, book and pay for services. It also allows any user to offer their own services and manage clients, reservations and payments from the same account.
Can I use Wisdom as a client and as a professional?
Yes. You don't need to create two accounts. You can use client mode to contract services and switch to professional mode when you want to offer yours.
Do I need an account to use Wisdom?
You can explore part of the application without registering, but you will need an account to book, send messages, save favorites, make payments, or publish services.
What kind of services can I find on Wisdom?
Wisdom is designed for all types of services: home, education, well-being, technology, design, pets, events, renovations, advice and many more, both in person and online.
Who provides the service I reserve?

The Provider identified in the offer and reservation contracts directly with you, performs the work and is responsible for its obligations. Wisdom facilitates search, booking, payment, documents and support as an intermediary; does not execute or resell that work.
What does a verified profile or Premium badge mean?

A verification only confirms the specific check indicated, for example identity or payment requirements. It does not certify tax registration, licenses, insurance or service quality. The Premium badge identifies a subscription, not professional verification.
Search and contact
How do I find a service?

You can search directly for what you need or explore Wisdom families and categories. You can then filter and compare services based on factors such as price, location, rating, experience or availability.
Why is Wisdom asking me for a location?
The location allows you to show services that can really serve you and calculate the distance with in-person professionals. Online services can be found regardless of your location.
Can the professional see my address before booking?
The address is used when it is necessary to provide the service. Wisdom limits public location information and does not unnecessarily display exact addresses in profiles or results.
What happens if I am outside the professional's travel radius?
Wisdom can alert the professional if the address is outside its usual radius. If it is too far away – equal to or greater than twice your configured radius – the reservation cannot be made.
Can I speak to a professional before booking?
Yes, if the professional has enabled previous questions. Before booking, the conversation may be limited to a maximum of messages to resolve specific questions.
Why can't I send my phone or email before booking?

Wisdom attempts to keep hiring and communication within the platform to preserve history, payments, and support tools. This is why certain contact details may be blocked before confirming a reservation.
Can I hire the professional outside of Wisdom?

Wisdom is designed so that hiring is done within the platform. If you move the operation abroad, Wisdom may not have the necessary information to offer its payment, tracking, documentation or support mechanisms.
What is a consultation?
Some professionals allow you to book a short consultation before or independently of the main service. It can be in person, by call or video call and free or paid as configured by the professional.
Reservations
How does a reservation work?

The client selects the necessary data, reviews the price and pays the deposit. The professional receives a request and can accept or reject it. Once accepted, both parties can follow and manage the entire service from Wisdom.
Does booking mean that the appointment is already confirmed?
Not necessarily. When making a reservation you may first be sending a request. The reservation is confirmed when the professional accepts it.
How much time does the professional have to accept?

It depends on how much is left for the service. Wisdom shows the time available in the reservation itself. If the application expires without being accepted, it is canceled and the deposit is returned.
If the reservation does not have a start date and time, the request normally expires after 24 hours.
What happens if the professional rejects my request?
The reservation is canceled and you receive a full refund of the deposit.
Can I book without choosing a date?
In certain services yes. The date, time or duration may be optional depending on the type of service. Recurring reservations, on the other hand, require specific programming.
Can I book without indicating the duration?
Yes, when the type of service allows it. In that case the price or availability may need to be finalized later.
What do the statuses of a reservation mean?

A reservation may be requested, accepted, in progress, pending approval, completed, canceled, rejected, expired or in dispute. The reservation detail will always tell you what is happening and if you need to take any action.
When does the service actually start?
Accepting a reservation does not mean starting work. The professional must mark “Start service” when it actually starts and Wisdom registers that moment as the start.
How is a service terminated?
When the work is finished, the professional indicates this from the reservation and confirms the final amount when applicable. The customer can review the result and complete the payment.
Changes to a reservation
Can I modify a request that has not yet been accepted?
You can modify its description. To change other details of a pending request, you will normally have to cancel it and rebook with the new details.
Can I modify an already accepted booking?
Yes. A modification proposal is sent to the other party. The change only applies when both parties agree.
What can the other person do with a change request?
You can accept it, reject it or make a counterproposal. Until there is an agreement, the previous booking conditions remain valid.
What happens if no one responds to a modification?

The proposal may expire when the original service time arrives, the new proposed time arrives, or the reservation advances to another state. If it expires, the reservation maintains its previous conditions.
Price, deposit and payments
What am I paying when making a reservation?
Normally you pay a deposit first and, when the service ends, the remaining amount. The price may include the corresponding professional settlement and the Wisdom Service Fee.
What is the Service Fee?
It is the price of Wisdom's intermediation and tools: payment management, support, traceability and own documentation. It is not insurance or a guarantee of the Provider's work.
It is currently calculated as 10% of the professional's settlement + €0.50, with a minimum of €1.
Who pays the Service Fee and who receives the rest?

The fee is paid by the Client and corresponds to Wisdom. The amount of the work corresponds to the Provider. Stripe processes separate payments and transfers; Wisdom may temporarily hold a transfer pending and handle adjustments or returns in accordance with its policies, without becoming a provider of the work.
What is the deposit?

It is the amount paid when requesting a reservation to confirm the commitment. It is not an additional cost: it normally represents all or part of the Service Fee and is taken into account within the total price.
Is the deposit always the same?
No. It depends on the type of price and the reservation estimate. For services where the price cannot yet be known, the deposit may be €1.
How does a fixed price service work?
The price of the work is known from the beginning. The deposit is paid when booking and the remaining amount when the service ends.
How does an hourly service work?
When booking, the expected duration is used to make an estimate. Upon completion, the final price is calculated using the actual duration of the service.
If it ultimately lasts longer or shorter than expected, Wisdom adjusts the final payment.
How does a service with a price to be agreed upon work?
The final price is not known when booking. A deposit of €1 is initially paid and, when the service ends, the professional proposes its final settlement for the client to review.
Can the final price be different from the initial price?
Yes, especially in hourly or budget services. Wisdom shows the client the final amount before closing when approval is required.
What happens if I don't respond to the final price?
Normally you have 48 hours. If the amount is equal to, less than, or a maximum of 20% more than the initial estimate and the other conditions are met, Wisdom can collect automatically.

If the increase exceeds 20%, there was no comparable estimate or one of the expected exceptions occurs, your intervention will be necessary and, if it is not resolved, the reservation may be disputed.
Can I be charged automatically if I paid with Apple Pay?
No. For reservations paid via Apple Pay, subsequent payments that require authorization will need to be confirmed again.
Can I change the card for the final payment?
Yes, where necessary you can use another available payment method.
Does Wisdom save my full card details?
Payments are processed through specialized providers such as Stripe. Wisdom uses secure tokenization mechanisms and does not need to directly store all the complete card data.
Why do I see a price in my currency but the charge is different?
Services are charged in their original currency. If Wisdom shows a conversion to your currency, it is indicative and the final amount may vary due to the exchange rate or the conditions of your bank.
What happens if a payment fails?
Wisdom will ask you to resolve the problem or use another payment method. A failed attempt does not mean that a legitimate outstanding amount disappears.
Cancellations, problems and disputes
Can I cancel a reservation?
Yes. Refund depends on who cancels and how long it takes to start service.
What is a last-minute cancellation?
Wisdom calculates a period equivalent to 33% of the time between the creation of the reservation and its start, with a minimum of 1 hour and a maximum of 24 hours.
Reservations without a start time do not have a last minute period.
What happens if the client cancels with enough notice?
The deposit is fully returned.
What happens if the client cancels at the last minute?
The deposit is not returned.
What happens if the professional cancels?
The customer receives the full refund. If the cancellation is at the last minute or after the scheduled time, Wisdom may register an incident in the professional account.
What happens if the client does not show up?
The other party may communicate a default. If confirmed, the reservation is canceled and the customer may lose the deposit.
What happens if the professional does not show up?
If confirmed, the client receives a full refund and Wisdom can register an incident in the professional's account.
What if there is a problem with work?

You can report it or open a dispute. Wisdom reviews relevant evidence, listens to the parties and can facilitate agreements and manage the reservation or its payments. The Provider remains responsible for the work and any damages attributable to it.
What is the difference between reporting a problem and opening a dispute?
Reporting a problem allows you to record an incident. A dispute stops the normal flow of the reservation and requires the situation to be resolved before continuing.
What can Wisdom resolve in a dispute?

Wisdom may take justified operational measures concerning the booking and payments, such as postponing a transfer or processing a full or partial refund. It does not act as an arbitrator or offer damage insurance. You can request a review from support and retain your rights to bring a claim against the appropriate party.
Can I withdraw the dispute and what happens to other claims?

Whoever opened it can withdraw it and the reservation returns to its original state. A closure or refund does not in itself waive legal rights. Ordinary financial assistance refers to the amounts in the reserve; Any extraordinary business assistance requires an express grant from Wisdom and does not create blanket coverage.
What if no one does anything after service time?

Wisdom can send reminders after the scheduled start. If an accepted reservation remains abandoned for 7 days without activity, it can be automatically canceled, the deposit refunded to the client and an incident registered with the professional.
Recurring reservations
What is a recurring reservation?
It allows you to schedule the same service periodically, for example every week or every two weeks, without having to manually book each session.
How often can it repeat?
It can currently be configured every 1, 2, 3, or 4 weeks and on one or more days of the week.
Are all future sessions created at startup?
No. Wisdom generates sessions progressively. Normally a new session is created 72 hours before its start.
Is the entire series charged at once?
No. Each session has its own deposit and its own payment.
What happens if a date in the series is already booked?
Wisdom may skip certain sessions that conflict with other bookings. A session that cannot be generated is not charged.
Can I modify only one session?
Yes. A specific session can be managed independently without necessarily modifying the entire series.
Can I change the entire recurrence?
Certain changes may be proposed for future sessions. Sessions that have already been generated must be managed individually where appropriate.
Can I pause a recurrence?
Yes. A manual pause must be requested in advance and requires the acceptance of the other party. Upcoming confirmed reservations may have to be managed individually.
Can I end a recurrence?
Yes. Terminating it prevents new sessions from being created, but does not automatically cancel reservations that have already been generated.
What happens if payment for a recurring session fails?

Wisdom makes the intended attempts and allows you to correct the payment method. If you cannot be charged before the set limit, that session can be skipped without automatically canceling the entire series.
Repeated failures in different sessions can temporarily pause the recurrence.
Offer services
How do I start offering services?
Switch to professional mode and create your first service. You can configure what you offer, category, description, location, images, experience, price and conditions.
Do I have to stop being a client to become a professional?
No. Both modes are part of the same account and you can switch between them whenever you want.
How many services can I publish?
The free plan allows you to keep up to 2 active services. Wisdom Premium allows up to 10.
Can I edit a service after publishing it?
Yes. From your Services section you can manage and update published services.
Can I temporarily hide a service?
Yes. Hiding it prevents it from continuing to appear publicly without deleting all your information.
Existing reservations remain valid.
Can I delete a service?
Yes, as long as there are no reservations or active series that prevent doing so. Wisdom may demand that outstanding commitments be resolved first.
How is my availability calculated?
Wisdom takes into account your existing reservations, their durations and the margins between services to try to avoid overlaps.
Recurring reservations can also block future availability based on your pattern.
Why is there a margin between reservations?
Reservations with a defined time and duration can block 30 minutes before and after. This margin allows for travel, preparation, possible delays and time between services.
Do I have to accept all requests?
No. A request is not an obligation until you accept it. You can accept or reject it according to your availability.
What do I need to accept reservations and get paid?
Wisdom may require that you have a payment method set up and complete necessary verifications. These checks allow you to process payments securely and comply with applicable obligations.
Why does Wisdom need to verify my identity?
Payment providers may need to verify identity and certain details before allowing you to receive money. The documents used for this verification are not publicly displayed.
How do I start and end a job?
When you actually start, press “Start Service”. When finished, use the end option and confirm the corresponding duration or price depending on the type of service.
When do I receive money for my services?

In the standard system, eligible settlements are processed on the first Wednesday after at least 7 days have passed since collection from the customer. Once the transfer is sent, it may take approximately 1–2 additional business days for the bank.
Why is a transfer delayed and am I guaranteed payment?

The calendar allows you to manage incidents and can be suspended for amounts affected by disputes, fraud, chargebacks or legal requirements. Justified withholdings will be reviewed. Wisdom does not guarantee the collection of amounts that have not been received or whose return is appropriate.
Does Premium allow you to charge earlier?
Eligible Premium Professionals may have faster release conditions when they meet applicable requirements. The specific conditions are shown in the Wisdom Premium Policy.
What is vacation mode?
Allows you to indicate a period in which you will not be able to attend certain services. In recurring reservations you can prevent new sessions from being generated during that period.
Reservations that are already confirmed may require cancellation or individual management.
Billing and taxes
Who issues the service invoice?

The Service Provider issues the invoice using their own means when legally required and may upload it to the booking. Wisdom does not generate or correct invoices on their behalf; it only issues documentation for its own charges. If the invoice for the work is missing, you must request it from the Service Provider.
Is Wisdom the party providing the service to the client?
No. Wisdom acts as an intermediary and provides the platform, while the contracted work is carried out by the corresponding professional.
Does Wisdom decide what taxes I have to pay as a professional?
No. Each professional is responsible for determining their fiscal and administrative obligations according to their situation and country.
Wisdom may request certain information necessary for payments or legal compliance, but using the platform is not a substitute for tax advice.
What does Individual or Self-Employed / Company mean?

It is the status declared by the Service Provider when setting up their payout method. Wisdom does not audit their tax situation. Individual does not mean exemption from taxes or invoices; Self-Employed / Company is not an accreditation by Wisdom. The term “professional” in the app describes the role of someone offering a service.
Do I have the same rights when hiring an individual?

If the Service Provider does not in fact act as a trader or professional, consumer protection legislation does not apply to the contract for the work. The declaration must be shown before booking. It does not affect your rights against Wisdom for the platform service or remove those arising from the Service Provider’s actual status. The person making a false selection is responsible for it.
Where do I see the documents and what happens if there is no invoice?

The reservation includes the receipt or informative summary, Wisdom's own invoices and the invoice provided by the Provider, if it exists. The receipt does not replace a mandatory invoice. If the tax label is incorrect, the Lender must correct it and deliver the required documentation.
Can Wisdom give me information about the other party to claim?

Wisdom may provide the details strictly necessary where there is a legal basis and a connection with a specific claim. It does not automatically disclose identity documents, bank details or the entire chat; the limits in the Privacy Policy apply.
Ratings and safety
When can I leave a review?
After successfully completing a reservation and making final payment. Each completed reservation allows for an independent assessment.
Can I evaluate the same professional several times?
Yes, if you have made several different reservations with it. Each service completed can generate its own rating.
Can a professional delete a negative review?
Not simply because it is negative. Wisdom may moderate content that violates the rules, is fraudulent, offensive or does not correspond to a real experience.
What can I do if I see a suspicious service?
You can use the reporting options available on the platform or contact support.
Is it safer to pay within Wisdom?
Maintaining the reservation, communication and payment within the platform allows you to maintain traceability and use the support, dispute, refund and documentation mechanisms available in Wisdom.
Wisdom Premium
What is Wisdom Premium?
It is a subscription that adds benefits for clients and professionals, especially in price, visibility, and professional tools.
How much does it cost?
In Spain, the monthly plan costs €14.99 and the annual plan costs €149. In other countries or stores, the corresponding price will be shown before contracting.
What happens to the Service Fee if I have Premium?
The ordinary Service Fee is eliminated and only a minimum deposit of €1 per reservation is maintained.
Does the discount work if only one of the two people is Premium?
Yes. If the client or professional has Premium when the booking conditions are set, the benefit applies.
What advantages does Premium have for professionals?

It may include visibility, a badge, statistics, priority support, up to 10 active services and faster payouts where eligible. It does not certify the Service Provider, guarantee income or include a Service guarantee, damage coverage or a favorable resolution of disputes.
Does Premium guarantee that I will appear first?
No. Premium may improve visibility or positioning, but does not guarantee a specific position or a certain number of bookings.
What happens if I cancel Premium?
Canceling deactivates automatic renewal, but you maintain Premium until the end of the period you have already paid for.
What happens to my services if Premium ends?
If you have more than the 2 services allowed on the free plan, they will not be deleted. Some will be hidden until you reduce the number of active services or return to Premium.
Does losing Premium change the price of a reservation I already made?
Not retroactively. The economic conditions that have already been set for a reservation are maintained.
How does Premium work on iPhone?
On iOS, the subscription is purchased and managed through the App Store. Apple manages the payment method, renewals, cancellations, plan changes and receipts.
Account and help
Can I change the language or currency?
Yes. You can configure your preferences from Settings. Currency displayed may be used for ease of reading, although services are charged in their original currency where applicable.
Can I save multiple addresses?
Yes. You can save and manage addresses to use them more quickly for future bookings.
Can I save multiple cards?
Yes, when the functionality is available for your method and platform. You can manage your payment methods from Settings.
What do I do if I have forgotten my password?
Use the password recovery option. Wisdom will send a code to the associated email so you can establish a new one.
Why am I not receiving notifications?
Check that notifications are enabled in both Wisdom and your device settings. They are especially useful for requests, messages, payments and changes to reservations.
Can I delete my account?
Yes, from the account options, as long as there are no active obligations or operations that must be resolved first.
Certain information may be retained for as long as legally required even after account deletion.

You can contact support from the Help section or through the support chat within Wisdom.
