blocks.text: This Policy details the issuance, management and retention of financial documents under the current version 0.1: Wisdom issues documents for its own transactions and allows documents issued by the Service Provider to be uploaded. It does not offer to issue documents for or on behalf of Service Providers.

Wisdom is a brokerage platform. Therefore, the same reservation may comprise two legally differentiated operations: the service provided by the professional to the client and the platform services provided by Wisdom.
This separation determines who must issue each invoice and who assumes the corresponding tax obligations.
1. Two different economic concepts
The price of a reservation can be made up of:
Settlement of the professional: amount corresponding to the service performed by the professional.
Wisdom service fee: amount corresponding to the intermediation services, infrastructure, payments, support and other functionalities provided by Wisdom.
Unless there is an applicable Premium benefit, the ordinary Service Fee is 10% of the professional's settlement + €0.50, with a minimum of €1.
Both concepts can be part of the same payment to facilitate the customer experience, but they correspond to different operations and may require separate tax documentation.
2. Service Fee Invoice
Where legally applicable, Wisdom will issue the invoice for its own Service Fee.
This invoice will document exclusively the services provided by Wisdom and not the professional activity carried out by the provider.

The invoice will identify Oier Hernanz Arroyo as the issuer, under the trade name Wisdom, with his current tax details; the recipient where applicable; the transaction, the amount and the applicable taxes. “Wisdom, S.L.” will not be used as though it were the issuing entity.
The professional is not the issuer of this invoice nor is it liable for Wisdom's own income.
3. Professional service invoice
The material provision of the service is carried out between the professional and the client.
The invoice for the work, when there is a legal obligation to issue it, will be issued by the Provider to the Client through its own means and may be attached to the reservation.
The professional continues to be the taxpayer with respect to said operation even if the payment has been processed through Wisdom.
The use of the platform does not convert Wisdom into the service provider nor does it transfer to Wisdom the tax obligations of the professional.
4. Documents provided by the Lender
The Provider generates and issues its invoice outside the Wisdom issuing system, with its identity, numbering, content and taxes.

The Service Provider may upload the file to the booking so that the Client can view or download it. This action authorizes the necessary storage and availability, not the issuance of documents by Wisdom on the Service Provider’s behalf.
The Lender remains the issuer and responsible for the authenticity, accuracy and tax compliance of the document. Wisdom does not sign or issue the invoice for the Service.
Format, technical integrity or file security controls are not equivalent to an audit of the invoice or a validation of its tax treatment.
Wisdom may record who provides the document, the reservation, the time of upload and its history, with the guarantees and conservation limits of the Privacy Policy.
5. Responsibility for data and document
Attaching an invoice to Wisdom does not modify the Lender's tax responsibility.
The professional must keep the data necessary to issue their documents correctly updated and will be responsible, among other aspects, for:
Your identity and NIF or tax identifier.
Your tax address.
Your tax situation.
The tax treatment of your activity.
The type of VAT or other applicable tax.
Possible exemptions.
The assumptions of reversal of the taxable person when applicable.
Any other necessary tax information.

Wisdom does not audit registrations or the declared tax situation and does not provide personalized tax advice. Identity checks, payments, diligence and legally required communications are maintained, and the possibility of acting in the event of signs of irregularity.
6. Individual and Self-Employed / Company

Individual is the natural person who selects and confirms that condition without Wisdom having audited their tax situation. Self-employed / Company is someone who declares to be registered and act as a businessman or professional. Both categories describe stated information and not accreditation from Wisdom.

The actual legal status depends on the activity. A label does not exempt from taxes, registrations, invoices or licenses. Whoever is obliged must issue their document, correct its classification if it is incorrect and deliver it by an appropriate means even if a function of the app is not available.

The declaration is made when setting up the payout method and must be kept up to date. Self-Employed / Company requires express acceptance of its accuracy and responsibility, with the scope established in the Terms. Not having a payout method or not having answered does not constitute a declaration of acting as a private individual.
7. Issuance and content of invoices

The invoices issued by Wisdom will incorporate the information required by the applicable regulations. The Provider must guarantee by its own means that its invoice meets the corresponding requirements.
Where applicable, they may include:
Number and series.
Issue date.
Date of the operation when different.
Identification of the issuer.
Identification of the recipient when necessary.
Service description.
Tax base.
Tax rate.
Tax fee.
Total amount.
Special tax mentions when applicable.
Reservation reference.

The invoice file supplied by the Service Provider will retain its original issuer and content. Wisdom will not replace the Service Provider’s identity with the platform’s brand or generate a consolidated invoice for the work in Wisdom’s name.
8. Numbering and series
Invoices must maintain an orderly and correlative numbering within the corresponding series.

Wisdom will use its own series for its invoices and corrective invoices. It will not assign or use up Service Providers’ tax invoice numbers; each Service Provider will manage their series outside Wisdom’s invoice issuance system.
The corrective invoices will use the specific series that correspond in accordance with the applicable regulations.
The number of an invoice already issued cannot be reused for a different operation.
9. Invoices already issued
An issued invoice is not silently modified or replaced when the circumstances of a transaction subsequently change.
When an invoice must be corrected in accordance with applicable regulations, the corresponding corrective document will be issued.
This preserves traceability between the original document and any subsequent corrections.
10. Corrective invoices and refunds
A cancellation, refund or adjustment of the amount may require a rectification of a previously issued invoice.
Where applicable, Wisdom will generate a corrective invoice for its own amounts.
For example, if a previously invoiced Service Fee is returned in whole or in part, the system may generate the necessary tax document to reflect such modification.

If the invoice concerns the work, the Service Provider must issue and supply the corrective invoice. Wisdom may record the refund and host the document, but does not generate or correct it on the Service Provider’s behalf.
In the interface, Wisdom may use more understandable names such as “Refund”, as long as the tax document retains the corresponding legal nature internally and in its content.
11. Final price adjustments
In certain services, especially those charged by the hour or under a budget, the final amount may not coincide with the initial estimate.
If the professional settlement increases, the Service Fee may also increase and documentation corresponding to the additional amounts may be generated.
If the final amount decreases and there is a return of previously invoiced amounts, the legally corresponding rectifications will be made.
The documents issued will always reflect the amounts actually applicable to the final operation.
12. Deposits
The deposit is part of the economic system of the reservation and does not necessarily constitute an independent concept of the final price.
Its documentary treatment will depend on the nature of the amount being charged and the applicable regulations.
When an advance payment corresponding to a Wisdom operation must be documented by invoice, Wisdom will issue the corresponding document.
If said amount is subsequently returned or adjusted, the appropriate tax regularization will be carried out.
13. Wisdom Premium
When Premium eliminates the ordinary Service Fee, only the amounts that actually correspond to Wisdom will be documented.
The Premium application does not modify the professional's responsibility for the billing of their own service.

In recurring reservations, each session will maintain the economic and fiscal conditions that correspond to it based on the rules applicable at the time it is established or the corresponding payment occurs.
14. Reservation Summary
Wisdom may generate a Reserve Summary to facilitate the understanding of an operation.
This document can visually gather information such as:
Contracted service.
Professional.
Client.
Service amount.
Service fee.
Payments made.
Refunds.
Related documents.

The Booking Summary is informative and must expressly state this: it is not an invoice for the work nor does it replace legally required invoices. It will separate the amount of the Provider and the Service Fee and will not present Wisdom as the issuer of the entire service.

When there are several documents, they can be downloaded together, preserving the identity and content of each issuer. If the Provider has not yet provided its invoice, its absence will be indicated without generating a substitute.
15. Client tax data
The client may provide or update the tax data necessary for the issuance of their documents.
Changes made after the issuance of an invoice will not automatically modify documents already issued.
When a document already issued contains incorrect data and its correction is legally necessary, the applicable rectification procedure will be used.
The user is responsible for providing true and updated data.
16. VAT, exemptions and other taxes
Each issuer is responsible for the tax treatment of its own operations.
Wisdom will determine and apply the taxes corresponding to the services that it provides in accordance with its tax situation and the applicable regulations.
The professional will be responsible for determining the taxes applicable to their services.

The Service Provider determines and applies the taxes on their invoice using their own means. Under this arrangement, Wisdom does not request tax settings in order to generate invoices on the Service Provider’s behalf.

The information stated or contained in an uploaded file does not constitute validation by Wisdom. The absence of an audit does not exempt the Provider or Wisdom from their respective legal obligations.
17. International operations
Tax obligations may vary depending on the country of establishment of the parties, the location of the service, the business status of the recipient and other circumstances.
Wisdom may adapt the documentation, taxes or information requested when necessary to comply with applicable regulations.
The professional remains responsible for determining his or her own international tax obligations where applicable.
18. Currency
Invoices and documents linked to a reservation will reflect the currency in which the operation was legally carried out.
Wisdom may display indicative conversions in other currencies to facilitate user understanding.
These conversions do not replace the actual amount of the transaction or the amount reflected in the tax documentation.
19. Premium Billing
When a Premium subscription is charged directly by Wisdom, confirmed charges may generate the corresponding invoice.
Each renewal or independent collection will be documented in accordance with applicable regulations.
No invoice will be issued for failed payment attempts or for operations that have not resulted in a collection.

When Premium is contracted through the App Store and it is Apple who processes and documents the operation, Wisdom will not issue a second invoice presenting itself as the one who has directly made that charge.
20. Conservation and access to documents
Wisdom may retain invoices and other tax documentation for the legally required periods.
Users will be able to access the available documents using the functions enabled in the application.

The conservation of information will continue when it is necessary for tax, accounting, administrative obligations, fraud prevention, disputes or defense of rights, even if an account is subsequently closed.
21. Information to the authorities
Wisdom will comply with the legal information obligations applicable to the platform.
This may include the collection, verification and communication of financial or tax information from certain providers in accordance with standards such as DAC7.
These communications do not mean that Wisdom files the professional's personal tax returns or assumes the payment of their taxes.
22. Fiscal responsibility
Each party is responsible for its own tax obligations.

The Service Provider is responsible for their income, documents, declared data, registrations, taxes and other obligations arising from their activity. Falsehood or non-compliance on their part does not make Wisdom a guarantor of the Service or of their tax situation, without prejudice to Wisdom’s own responsibilities.
The client will be responsible for providing correct information when requesting tax documentation in their name.
Wisdom will be responsible for its own obligations as a platform and the tax documentation that it is legally required to issue.
The use of Wisdom tools does not exempt any party from complying with the regulations that apply to it.
23. Changes to this Policy
Wisdom may modify this Policy to adapt it to legislative, fiscal, technological or functional changes.
When a modification is relevant to users, it will be communicated through the appropriate means.
24. Contact
For queries related to invoices, tax documents, collections or refunds, you can contact the Wisdom support team from the application.

Wisdom Premium is the Wisdom subscription for users who want to use the platform with more advantages, both when contracting services and when offering them.

This Policy explains what Premium includes, its price, renewal, cancellation and termination. Premium is a Wisdom platform service, whose owner is Oier Hernanz Arroyo; It does not change who provides each job nor does it transfer the fiscal, professional or execution obligations of the Providers to Wisdom.
1. Available plans
Wisdom Premium has two modalities:
Monthly plan: €14.99 per month.
Annual plan: €149 per year.
The annual plan represents an approximate saving of 16% compared to paying twelve monthly payments, taking these prices as a reference.

The above prices are those defined for Spain. In the App Store and other markets, the price, currency and possible taxes displayed at the time of purchase will be those applicable to that subscription.
Before contracting, Wisdom will always show the selected plan and its price.
2. Premium Benefits
Premium is designed to offer advantages both to those who contract services and, especially, to those who offer them regularly within Wisdom.
Available benefits will be displayed before hiring. Some functionalities may depend on your technical availability, country, platform or version of Wisdom.
2.1. No service fee
The main economic benefit of Premium is the elimination of the ordinary Service Fee.
Typically, a booking may include a Service Fee equal to 10% of the professional's settlement + €0.50, with a minimum of €1.

When Premium applies, the ordinary fee is removed and only a minimum amount of €1 per booking remains, charged as a deposit and included in the total. A transaction with no platform cost is not offered.
The benefit works both ways.
If you are Premium and book the service of another professional, you enjoy this advantage even if that professional does not have Premium.
If you are a Premium professional, clients who book your services also benefit from the elimination of the Service Fee, making the final price of your services more competitive.
If either party has Premium when the economic conditions of the reservation are set, the corresponding benefit will be applied.
2.2. Greater visibility and positioning
Premium can provide greater visibility to services within Wisdom.
Premium user services may appear more prominently in certain search results, recommendations and discovery spaces when the corresponding positioning system is available.
This advantage seeks to increase the chances that a service will be discovered and considered by potential clients.

Premium does not guarantee, however, a specific position, a specific number of views or obtaining reservations. Results may also depend on factors such as search relevance, location, availability, quality and completeness of service, reputation and other criteria used by Wisdom.
23. Expedited collections
Premium professionals who meet the requirements established by Wisdom can access a faster release of the amounts corresponding to their services.

For this, conditions may be required such as having the identity and payment account verified, the payment account correctly configured, not presenting reliability incidents and being within the limits established by Wisdom.
For eligible settlements of up to €200, Wisdom can process the payment release immediately. If all the necessary requirements are not met, the release may take place after 48 hours.

Release does not mean instant arrival at the bank: the provider or financial institution may need approximately 1 or 2 additional business days. The time limits and benefits do not remove justified holds, verifications, chargebacks, provider restrictions or legal obligations, nor do they guarantee the Service Provider amounts that have not been collected or that must be refunded.
2.4. Premium Badge
While Premium is active, Wisdom may display a Premium badge next to the user's name in relevant places on the platform, such as services, search results, profiles or bookings.
This badge allows you to easily identify a Premium account and visually differentiate it within Wisdom.

The badge identifies a Premium subscription. It does not establish the Service Provider’s identity, tax registration, self-employed or company status, authorization, insurance, quality of work or legal compliance.
2.5. Advanced statistics
Premium can give access to more complete statistics on the performance of services.
These metrics may include information on visibility, interest generated, reservations or other useful data to better understand the performance of the offer and help the professional improve it.
The specific statistics available may evolve as Wisdom incorporates
2.6. Up to 10 active services
A free account can maintain up to 2 active services.
With Premium, up to 10 active services can be maintained.
This allows you to expand the offer, publish different services and increase the chances of appearing in different searches or categories.
If Premium ends and you have more active services than the free plan allows, Wisdom will not delete any or delete your information.
Up to 2 may remain publicly active and the rest will be hidden due to the plan limit. You can reactivate them if you recover Premium or reduce the number of active services.
Existing reservations linked to these services will continue to operate normally.

2.7. Priority support
Premium users can receive priority attention for queries or incidents related to reservations, payments, services or the operation of Wisdom.
This means that your requests may receive a higher priority within the support system.

Priority concerns support handling, not the decision in a dispute. It does not ensure an immediate or favorable resolution, a Service guarantee, damage insurance or financial compensation. The same rules on evidence, refunds and responsibilities provided for the platform apply.
3. Automatic renewal
Premium is an auto-renewing subscription.
This means that, unless you cancel the renewal, the plan will be charged again at the end of each monthly or annual period.
Before contracting, you can check the frequency and applicable price.
When Premium is active, Wisdom will display, where applicable, the date of the next payment or the date until which you will retain Premium.
4. Cancel Premium
Canceling Premium means canceling your automatic renewal.
You don't lose the benefits immediately.
If you have already paid for a monthly or annual period, you will continue to enjoy Premium until that period ends. Afterwards, a new renewal will not be carried out.
For example, if you cancel an annual plan with several months left to pay, Premium will remain active until the corresponding end date.
Canceling the renewal does not in itself generate a refund of the period already paid.
Where a right to refund applies under applicable law or the terms of the subscription provider, this right will be respected.
5. Reactivate renewal
If you have canceled the renewal but still have Premium, you will be able to activate it again before the end of the current period.
Reactivating the renewal does not normally involve making a new charge at that time.
The next payment will occur when the period already paid ends, according to the conditions shown before confirming the reactivation.
6. Premium on iPhone and iPad
On iOS devices, Wisdom Premium is purchased through App Store subscriptions.
Apple manages collection, payment method, renewals, cancellations and plan changes.
Wisdom does not directly receive or store the card used to pay for a Premium subscription contracted through the App Store.
To cancel, reactivate, change or manage such a subscription, the user may be directed to Apple's subscription management.
The prices and currencies displayed during checkout on iOS are those provided by the App Store.
The receipts corresponding to these charges are also managed by Apple.
7. Premium outside of iOS
When Premium is purchased directly through Wisdom using a provider such as Stripe, Wisdom will be able to manage the subscription and your payment method.
The subscription will be activated only after the corresponding operation has been successfully confirmed.

If a payment requires additional authentication or cannot be completed, Premium will not be considered renewed until the provider confirms the payment or maintains access during an applicable grace period.
8. Change plan
You can switch between the monthly and annual plan.
How and when the change occurs depends on the provider managing the subscription.
On iOS, changes between both plans are managed according to App Store rules and may take effect at the next renewal.

When the subscription is managed directly by Wisdom, a change from monthly to annual can be applied immediately taking into account the period already paid, while a change from annual to monthly can be scheduled for when the year already paid ends.
Before confirming a change, it will be shown when it will take effect and if it involves an immediate charge.
9. Payment failures
If a renewal cannot be charged, Wisdom or the subscription provider may attempt to recover payment.
As long as the provider continues to recognize a grace period or maintains Premium access, Wisdom may retain the benefits.
If the subscription eventually expires, Premium will end.
When any action is necessary on the part of the user, they will be informed so that they can update or correct their payment method.
On iOS, any payment method issues will need to be resolved through Apple.
10. What happens when Premium ends?
When Premium is no longer active, the associated benefits for future operations are withdrawn.
This may affect the removal of the Service Fee, positioning, Premium badge, statistics, priority support, limit of active services and accelerated charges.
However, losing Premium does not retroactively change the conditions of a reservation that has already been set.
If a reservation was created benefiting from Premium, Wisdom will not subsequently add the Regular Service Fee solely because Premium has ended before completing that reservation.
11. Premium and recurring reservations

Therefore, each session preserves the economic conditions that have already been set or whose deposit has been collected.

Wisdom charges a Service Fee on bookings made through the platform.

The fee exclusively remunerates Wisdom's intermediation: infrastructure, payment management through specialized providers, support, traceability, own documentation and tools for incidents. It does not remunerate the execution of the work, it is not an insurance premium or a guarantee of quality, satisfaction or compensation for acts of the Provider.
1. How is it calculated?
The standard Service Fee is:
10% of the professional’s payout amount + €0.50, with a minimum of €1.
The payout amount is the amount that corresponds to the professional for performing the service.
If the calculation results in less than €1, the minimum fee of €1 will apply.
The client will be able to view the corresponding price before confirming a booking whenever it can be determined in advance.
2. Who pays the Service Fee?
The Service Fee is paid by the client.
The price of a booking is therefore divided into:
Professional’s payout amount: the amount corresponding to their work.
Service Fee: the amount corresponding to Wisdom.

Wisdom processes collections and transfers through Stripe and retains the applicable Service Fee; The amount of the work corresponds to the Provider. Temporary holds, adjustments, and refunds are handled according to accepted policies. Neither charging jointly nor distributing the amounts makes Wisdom the provider of the work.
3. What is the deposit?
When requesting a booking, the client pays a deposit.
The deposit is not an additional cost separate from the booking price. It normally represents all or part of the Service Fee that would apply to that transaction.
In this way, a small part of the booking is confirmed from the beginning and the remaining amount is paid when the service is completed.
If the booking is cancelled, rejected, or expires, the treatment of the deposit will depend on the conditions explained in the Cancellation Policy.
4. Fixed-price services
When the service has a fixed price, Wisdom knows the professional’s payout amount from the beginning and can calculate the corresponding Service Fee.
The deposit is charged when the request is made.
Once the service has been completed, the client pays the remaining amount.
5. Hourly services
When a service is charged by the hour, the final Service Fee depends on how long the service actually lasted.
If an estimated duration is indicated when booking, Wisdom uses that duration to initially calculate the deposit.
At the end of the service, the actual duration is used to calculate the final price.
If the service lasts longer than expected, the final payment will include the outstanding difference.
If it lasts less, Wisdom will adjust the amount so that the client pays only what corresponds to the final result.
Where no initial duration has been indicated and the price cannot yet be calculated, the minimum deposit of €1 may initially be charged.
6. Services with a price to be agreed
For some services, the price cannot be known in advance.
In these cases, an initial deposit of €1 is charged.
When the service ends, the professional indicates the final payout amount and Wisdom then calculates the Service Fee:
10% of the payout amount + €0.50, with a minimum of €1.
The euro already paid is taken into account in the final amount and is not charged again.
7. What happens if the final price changes?
The Service Fee is calculated using the professional’s final payout amount.
Therefore, it may differ from the amount initially estimated for hourly services or services subject to a quote.
If the final Service Fee is higher than the deposit already paid, the difference is added to the final payment.
If it is lower, Wisdom makes the corresponding adjustment so that the total amount charged is correct.
Before confirming the final payment, the client will be able to view its breakdown where applicable.
8. Wisdom Premium
When the client or professional has a Premium benefit applicable to the booking, the standard Service Fee may be removed.

In this case, a minimum amount of €1 per reservation is maintained, collected as a deposit and computed in the total price. The benefit eliminates the ordinary rate, but is not equivalent to a reservation without any platform cost nor does it include a Service guarantee.
The specific conditions and requirements of this benefit are explained in the Wisdom Premium Policy.
9. Cancellations and refunds
The fact that the deposit has been paid does not mean that it is always lost if a booking is cancelled.
Whether it is refunded depends on the timing and reason for the cancellation.
As a general rule, a cancellation made sufficiently in advance allows the deposit to be fully refunded, while certain last-minute cancellations or client no-shows may make it non-refundable.
The full rules are available in the Cancellation Policy.
10. Recurring bookings
Each session of a recurring booking has its own Service Fee and its own deposit.
Wisdom does not charge all sessions in the series in advance.
The deposit for each new session is charged when that session is generated, normally 72 hours before it begins.
If the service price, Service Fee, or Premium conditions change, the changes will only affect future sessions that have not yet been charged, in accordance with the recurring booking conditions.
